infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SkinIQ uses your camera to take a selfie for on-device skin analysis. Photos are analyzed on your device and are not required to be uploaded anywhere.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SkinIQ can use a photo from your library instead of the camera for skin analysis.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SkinIQ can save your scan photos to your library so you can track progress over time.
